# autonomous_ trading (AAAgents)

> autonomous_ trading (AAAgents) is an open source execution framework for rules-based trading. Users define their own strategy from deterministic rules, quant analytics and machine learning; the software executes it automatically, auditable and bounded by hard risk limits. Paper mode (simulated trading) is the default; live trading requires a deliberate, separately confirmed switch. AAAgents is a software tool: it gives no investment advice, does not pick investments and does not manage portfolios on behalf of its users.

Key facts:

- Licence: Apache-2.0, source code on GitHub.
- Editions: a free desktop version (Windows, macOS) for paper trading and a hardware tower edition; same trading core and risk engine.
- Decisions: 14 agents, 8 of them cast a directional vote; one sized signal comes out of the weighted vote; every action is written to a tamper-evident audit log.
- Broker: Alpaca (user's own account); paper mode is the default.
- Desktop installer available (Releases, see Download below).
- Broker access runs directly from the user's own installation to the user's own broker account; no third party holds the user's funds.
- Developed by AAAgents, Germany. The maintainers do not hold a BaFin authorisation; see the risk disclosure below.
